player_stats AS (
    SELECT player_id, 
        SUM(CASE WHEN (player_side = 'home' AND home_score > away_score) OR (player_side = 'away' AND away_score > home_score) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as wins,
        SUM(CASE WHEN (player_side = 'home' AND home_score < away_score) OR (player_side = 'away' AND away_score < home_score) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as losses
    FROM all_players
    GROUP BY player_id
)
SELECT p.player_api_id, p.player_name, ps.wins, ps.losses
FROM player_stats ps
JOIN Player p ON ps.player_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE ps.losses = (SELECT MAX(losses) FROM player_stats)
ORDER BY ps.losses DESC
